title: Use reduce to total the weight of each ingredient
goal: specifies the available initial accumulation value and summarizes the values ​​in the object item by item.
summary: Each item in the ingredient list has a weight in grams, and the total number of grams of all ingredients must be displayed. An empty table displays 0.
tasks: completes totalGrams(items) and uses reduce to accumulate the grams of each item.
input data is non-negative grams. Returns the number 0 when there are no ingredients.

example.note: callback returns the accumulated value of the next round. The trailing 0 is the initial value and also provides the return result for an empty array.

hint: The accumulator is numeric; the current item is an object, so item.grams is read.
